channel.title: Bounce Rumble
channel.description:
Real physics simulations where colors race, bounce and battle. Balls escape spinning rings, survive shrinking arenas and race down wild courses. Nothing is scripted: every race runs from a random seed, so nobody knows the winner until it happens.

Pick your color in the comments. New sims every day.

Homepage and privacy: https://develant.github.io/bounce-rumble/
